title: Closing the Update routine question loses the change for good
what: After a workout that changed its routine, the summary asks once whether to update the routine. If the member taps Keep original, presses back or taps outside by mistake, the question is gone and never comes back, and the saved workout offers no Update routine action. The only way left is Save as routine, which makes a second copy instead of updating the routine they follow.
expected: After closing the question there is still a way to update the original routine from that workout, for example an Update routine action on the saved workout page or a line on the summary.
how_often: each time a routine workout changed
fix_line: Keep an Update routine action on the summary and the saved workout page after the question is closed

items.reason: these files are logic only and draw no screen; tappable controls live in the screens and components areas. The only on-device controls they post are standard Android notification actions (Done, +15 s, Skip), drawn by the system
